title: Custom styles odt 002
notes: real ODF named styles: 3-level style:parent-style-name inheritance chain GP Base (12pt) -> GP Mid (italic) -> GP Leaf (14pt), plus a CHARACTER-family style GP Char (style:family="character", fo:font-weight bold) applied inline via text:span text:style-name. None of the five normative ODF counters match style elements, so feature counts stay 0; reference text is every visible paragraph string (style names themselves are not visible text).
